scope: Explicit real USB connection gate, independent readback and persistent recovery discovery
lifecycle_software_cases: A lost device locks controls; reconnection requires an explicit user action
Identity mismatch cannot retarget a session
Startup, disconnected polling and device reinsertion never auto-connect
Malformed probe invalidates stale connected state
Existing capture requires explicit restore in a fresh session
Ambiguous write retains recovery and is not retried
Owned capture restored before disconnect; closing rejects new writes
Connection gate disables editing/import/export/save, preserves drafts, and closes menus on USB loss
limits: New-session recovery was exercised using a fresh Rust Device session against the real canonical journal, not an actual OS crash in this pass.
Physical unplug/replug and sleep/wake were not newly performed.
No new optical color confirmation; readback verifies configuration.
D6 persistence/flash behavior remains unverified; explicit manual main-light writes only.
Strip writes, Windows hardware writes and automatic AI-to-HID mapping remain disabled.
Local NuPhy artwork cache is excluded from Git and not cleared for public binary distribution.
The shipped frontend contains no mock transport; browser tests inject a test-only Tauri bridge from desktop/tests.
